summary.text: Adriana Guzmán Fralick is the Republican nominee for Attorney General. A Reno lawyer who has held several state and local government legal posts but never elected office, she is endorsed by President Trump and campaigns on tougher sentencing, drug enforcement, and election security.

paragraphs.text: Earned a B.A. from the University of Nevada, Reno and a J.D. from the UNLV Boyd School of Law.

Served as legal counsel to the Nevada Commission on Ethics, general counsel to former Gov. Jim Gibbons, assistant general counsel to the Public Utilities Commission, and chaired the Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board.

Worked in the Carson City District Attorney's Office on civil matters; has not served as a criminal prosecutor and finished third of five in a 2012 State Board of Education race, her only prior run for office.
